high_level_description: The image is a news article headline and accompanying text from a political section of a publication. The headline reads: "Declassified Pentagon F-35 Study Details Reliability, Security Woes for America’s Costliest Weapon." Below the headline, there are two bullet points summarizing the content: Lack of reliable and ready jets marred years of combat testing. Issues include gun installations, repair times, cybersecurity. The main visual element is an image of a Lockheed Martin's F-35 fighter jet in flight against a clear blue sky.
